experiment: GPTQ act-order ablation after frozen-routing calibration (FR s0 / FC s0, layers 1/8/16/23, five groupings)
question: Are GPTQ's Hessian-dependent act-order permutation and its induced quantization-group membership responsible for a substantial fraction of the residual weight / PPL sensitivity under frozen routing?

conditions.AOF: GPTQ(H_AO,g) with actorder_override = captured ORIGINAL permutation P_O (new, 10 configs)

identification: AOF fixes the permutation AND the induced column->group membership jointly; scales, zeros, damping, Cholesky factor, error feedback are recomputed from H_AO,g

integrity_protocol.name: precision-aware installation integrity (actorder ablation); supersedes nothing: the frozen tolerance check of earlier studies is unchanged and still computed and reported for every configuration
integrity_protocol.I1: every one of the 720 installed BF16 projection tensors is bitwise equal to bfloat16(W_solver) of the FP32 solver output written back by E3 (checked at write-back for all 240 experts)
integrity_protocol.I2: for the 8 prespecified check experts (layers 1/8/16/23 x experts 0/30) the installed module's BF16 output on the frozen validation inputs is bitwise equal to an independent BF16 reference built from bfloat16(W_solver) with F.linear in the module's operation order (gate, up, act, mul, down)
integrity_protocol.I3: elementwise |W_bf16 - W_solver| <= 2^-8 |W_solver| (correct round-to-nearest; zeros stay zero) for all 720 tensors
integrity_protocol.I4: installed weights and checked outputs are finite
integrity_protocol.not_a_criterion: the relative FP32-vs-BF16 output deviation; it is reported (decomposed into weight representation and arithmetic) but never gates, because it measures the BF16 execution environment rather than installation correctness

frozen_old_tolerance: reported for every AOF configuration, unchanged, not gating

metrics.WeightReduction[c]: mean over the five groupings of 1 - D_AOF,g / D_AO,g, D = aggregate relative L2 of all 720 effective BF16 tensors vs OO (sqrt(sum ||W - W_OO||^2 / sum ||W_OO||^2))
metrics.SD_Delta_ratio: std_g(Delta_AOF,g) / std_g(Delta_AO,g), Delta = PPL_FC - PPL_FR (same grouping)
metrics.undefined_ratio: denominator <= 1e-12 -> undefined; an undefined ratio never satisfies a criterion

precedence: RUN-BLOCKED: installation audit not AUDIT-CONFIRMED-BF16-REPRESENTATION, a solver regression fails, an AOF configuration is missing or fails a correctness / integrity / invariance check (Hessian == AO, permutation == ORIGINAL, routed-token counts == R_O)
ACTORDER-MIXED-EFFECT: otherwise (the satisfied / failed items are reported)
decision_rule.note: exploratory practical criteria, frozen (with this module's sha256) before any AOF quantization or PPL

hard_constraints: no re-selection / new groupings / layers / strategies; GPTQ bits, group size, damping unchanged; scales and zeros never frozen; no forced routing at inference; earlier RUN-BLOCKED unchanged
